event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Panel of the International Jury was composed under RRS N1.4(b)
facts: Wind above 20 knots, waves up to 1,5 m.
GRE 208698 on starboard and POL 218577 on port on the beat to windward.
Boats were on converging course with GRE 208698 aiming just behind the middle of the hull of POL 218577.
GRE 208698 bore away at the distance 0,5 m and passed astern of POL 218577,
conclusions: There was reasonable doubt that POL 218577 could have crossed, if GRE 208698 had not taken avoiding action (see WS Case 50).
POL 218577 on port tack failed to keep clear of GRE 208698 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
decision: POL 218577 is DSQ in race no. 7.
